domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: tofler.in returned a different company's page for the CIN I guessed (Aditi Recovery Services, U74999MH2005PTC154123 — that CIN is NOT this company's, it was a wrong guess and is discarded), zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403, eximpedia/trademo/volza returned 403, importgenius returned a JS challenge, and the DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable ("Connection refused") for the whole session. Domestic supply therefore not verified either way — null, not invented.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated India customs export records with B/L numbers, destination ports and HS codes, latest 2025-11-30, consignees include Venus Safety & Health USA Inc (Miami) and RMA Shipping LLC (Jebel Ali). Declared HS 392690 (plastics) does not match the observed export codes — 65061090 (safety helmets), 63079091 (textile respirators), 90200000 (masks/filters) — so per project rule 3 the code should be corrected to the actual codes and the verdict kept as accepted_hs_corrected, not rejected. Role: manufacturer (own plant at MIDC Taloja, own brand 'Venus', plus imports of components/headforms from Hubei Hong Tu, Iru­dek, Mainpack, Ayon Safety — consistent with a producer that also trades). Revenue and export volume in value terms: null (not public on free views; ImportKey shows only record counts, not values). Domestic India supply: no evidence retrieved — 'следов поставок по внутреннему рынку не подтверждено' due to all registry/tender sources being blocked; this is a data-access gap, not a negative finding. No sanctions/court/owner-criminal matters were checked (out of scope for this role and not grounds for rejection per rule 2).
